description: Read an order from brainchain_post_task: the payment, the task's status on BrainChain, Jev's grade, the result text once the work is accepted, and the refund transaction if it is not. Call again after `retryAfterSeconds` until `done` is true. `next` says what the order's state means and what to do.
name: brainchain_get_task
title: Read a BrainChain order
